reason: S. boulardii in 269 children with otitis media or respiratory infections on antibiotics. Served counts 4/119 vs 22/127 printed ('four of 119'). Analysis 'based on allocated treatment' with data from 246 of 269, so the served ITT label is imprecise.
reviewed_note: S. boulardii in 269 children with otitis media or respiratory infections on antibiotics. Served counts 4/119 vs 22/127 printed ('four of 119'). Analysis 'based on allocated treatment' with data from 246 of 269, so the served ITT label is imprecise.

population.span: A total of 269 children (aged 6 months to 14 years) with otitis media and/or respiratory tract infections were enrolled in a double-blind, randomized placebo-controlled trial

endpoint.span: antibiotic-associated diarrhoea (diarrhoea caused by Clostridium difficile or otherwise unexplained diarrhoea)

estimate.span: [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]

ci.span: [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]

analysis_set.span: Analyses were based on allocated treatment and included data from 246 children.

treatment_strategy.span: they received standard antibiotic treatment plus 250 mg of S. boulardii (experimental group, n = 132) or a placebo (control group, n = 137) orally twice daily for the duration of antibiotic treatment.

follow_up.span: occurring during or up to 2 weeks after the antibiotic therapy

entry_population_reading.span: they received standard antibiotic treatment plus 250 mg of S. boulardii (experimental group, n = 132) or a placebo (control group, n = 137) orally twice daily for the duration of antibiotic treatment.

entry_population.extractor_why: The entry population comprises children receiving antibiotics, within the question's population; the intention-to-treat analysis requirement is not fully established.

extractor_mismatch_note: The corrected AAD numbers in served_row.source match the abstract.
